title: Absolutely Beautiful
description: Graphical modpack that doesn't turn your computer into an oven
body:
Absolutely Beautiful makes a (terrible) attempt to change the look of Minecraft to a different game, but tries to keep the feel. (_This description is also written terribly_)

## This modpack:
- Adds dust storms
- Rain is not as cluttered, drips down from walls and makes different sounds depending on which block it lands on
- Adds shaders
- Revamps footstep sounds
- Adds sound physics (echo in caves, muffled sounds when block is in way etc.)
- Optimises the game as much as possible
- Allows opening to internet (replaces Open to LAN)

And more!

Playing on a server may improve performance on some devices. Everything is client-side (which means you can use them on any server)

Everything here was attempted in the middle of the night, so it won't be Absolutely Beautiful. You are welcome to submit suggestions and fixes in our issue tracker.

**_[Credits to Fabulously Optimised for the base of the modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized)_**
